subject: How long does standard shipping take?
body: Hi, I'm thinking about ordering the Ridgeline 2 tent for a trip on the 20th. How long does standard shipping usually take to Fort Collins, Colorado? Is there a faster option if I'm cutting it close?

subject: Tent order stuck as delayed
body: My order was supposed to arrive last week. The tracking page now just says 'delayed' and there's no new date. I need the tent for a camping weekend on the 25th. Can you tell me what's going on and when it'll actually get here?

subject: Charged twice for one order
body: I placed one order for a down jacket and a pair of gloves, but my credit card statement shows two identical charges of $214.80 on the same day. I only got one confirmation email. Please refund the duplicate charge.

subject: Hiking boots too small, want to return
body: The Summit Trail boots I got are about half a size too small. I wore them around the house once but never outside. How do I return them? I'd prefer an exchange for a 10.5 if you have it in stock.

subject: GPS watch won't sync after firmware update
body: After updating my Kestrel Trailhead GPS watch to the latest firmware, it won't sync with the phone app anymore. It gets stuck at 'pairing' and then fails. I've restarted both the watch and my phone. I have a race this weekend and can't log anything right now.

subject: Password reset email never arrives
body: I've tried to reset my password four times today and never got the email. It's not in spam either. My email is the same one I used to order last year. How else can I get into my account?

subject: Do you have a store in Portland?
body: Is there a Kestrel Outfitters shop in Portland where I can try on rain jackets before buying? If not, is there anywhere that carries your gear?

subject: Order never arrived after three weeks
body: I ordered a sleeping bag and a backpack more than three weeks ago and have received nothing. The tracking link in my confirmation email doesn't show anything at all. I've been charged. I leave for a guided trip in four days and I'm really worried. Please help.

subject: Trekking poles arrived bent
body: One of the two carbon trekking poles in my order arrived bent in the middle; the box was crushed on one corner. I took photos of the box and the pole. I'd like a replacement as soon as possible, I can't use them like this.

subject: Camp stove leaking gas at the connector
body: My new Kestrel Ember camp stove hisses and I can smell gas where the canister screws into the stove, even when the valve is fully closed. I stopped using it right away. Is this a known problem? Is it safe to keep the canister attached? What should I do now?

subject: Gift card balance not applied at checkout
body: I have a $75 gift card from my sister. At checkout I entered the code, it said 'applied', but the total didn't change and my card was charged the full amount. Can you apply the gift card to that order or refund the difference?

subject: How do I change the email on my account?
body: I'm switching email providers. How do I change the email address on my Kestrel account without losing my order history?

subject: Package held at customs in Canada
body: My order to Toronto has been sitting at customs for days. DHL says import duties need to be paid. I thought the price included everything? Who is supposed to pay this and how?

subject: Still charged after cancelling my order
body: I cancelled my order the same day I placed it and got a cancellation email. Two weeks later the $389.00 charge is still on my card. When will I get my money back?

subject: Return window for sale items?
body: I'm looking at a few things in the end-of-season sale. If I buy them and they don't fit, can I still return them? Is the return window the same as for full-price items?

subject: Change jacket color on my order
body: I just ordered the Alpine Shell jacket in orange but I'd rather have it in navy, same size (M). The order still says processing. Can you swap the color before it ships?

subject: Refund for my jacket order
body:
Hi, I'd like to know how refunds work for my order.

subject: Account locked, can't see my orders
body: My account got locked after I mistyped my password a few times. Now it says 'too many attempts' every time I try, even with the right password. I need to see my order to print a return label. How long is the lock?

subject: Checkout error with PayPal
body: Every time I choose PayPal at checkout, the page shows 'Payment could not be processed. Please try again.' I've tried two browsers. A credit card might work but I'd rather use PayPal. Is something broken on your side?

subject: Change delivery address on a shipped order
body: I'm moving next week and just realized my order is going to my old address. Tracking says it's already shipped. Can you redirect it to my new address in Ogden?

subject: Is the footprint compatible with the Ridgeline 3?
body: Will the Ridgeline 2 footprint fit the Ridgeline 3 tent, or do I need the bigger one? The product pages don't say.

subject: Headlamp charging question
body:
How long should the Lumen 300 headlamp take to fully charge over USB-C?

subject: Feedback on the Alpine Shell jacket
body: Not a problem, just feedback: I wore the Alpine Shell on a week-long trip in Scotland and stayed dry the whole time. One suggestion: the hood drawcord is hard to reach with gloves on. Thanks for making good gear!

subject: Please delete my account and data
body: I don't shop online much anymore. Please close my Kestrel account and delete my personal data. Is there anything I need to do on my side?

subject: Which payment methods do you accept?
body: Do you accept Apple Pay or buy-now-pay-later options like Klarna? And do you charge my card when I order or when it ships?
